title: Timetable
description: Plan class times for each batch. Times use India time (Asia/Kolkata).
empty: No classes are scheduled this week.
cancelled: Class cancelled. It stays on record and leaves the active timetable.
confirmCancelBody: The class is marked cancelled. It is kept for later records and hidden from the active timetable.
endDateHelp: Leave the end date empty to create 8 weeks of classes. You will see the dates before anything is saved.
previewConflict: These dates overlap an existing class. Change the time or dates before saving.
previewRequired: Preview the dates before saving a repeat.
notFound: This class could not be found.
noBatches: Create an active batch before scheduling a class.
